identity.description: MrScraper is a web scraping platform offering a Scraper API (HTML, Markdown, screenshots, brand data, JSON), Web Search, workflows run through a Platform API, and an official MCP server.
identity.identity_notes: docs.mrscraper.com describes MrScraper as a web scraping platform; the official MCP repo sits in the mrscraper-com GitHub org. Matches the Data, SEO and Scraping category.

auth.oauth_flows: OAuth 2.1 browser sign-in applies only to the hosted MCP endpoint (https://mcp.mrscraper.com/mcp). No OAuth is documented for the REST API.
auth.scopes_notes: MCP OAuth approvals: account:read (status) and scrape:read (scraping and search tools).

access.production_restrictions: No app review found. The pricing page shows a Free plan but does not confirm it includes API token access.

resources: Scraper API (HTML, Markdown, screenshot, brand, JSON)
write_ops: Workflow rerun and manage via Platform API (methods and paths not documented)
api.limitations: The API overview lists only GET endpoints; Platform API methods and paths are not shown. No rate-limit documentation found. Base URL conflict: api.app.mrscraper.com/api/v1 in official docs vs api.mrscraper.com in a third-party skill file.
